_help.early_grace: Seconds BEFORE the yellow beat that still count as critical (touch fairness).
_help.late_grace: Seconds AFTER the yellow beat that still count as critical.
_help.input_cooldown: Seconds at the start of a swing during which presses are ignored (double-tap guard).
_help.stagger_time: Seconds of full lockout (no attack, no movement, no dodge) after spam or a dropped combo.
_help.lapse_time: Seconds after a swing before an unchained combo counts as dropped and staggers you.
_help.yellow_fraction: Size of the CRITICAL (gold) window as a fraction of the link window (0.25 = last quarter).
_help.weak_before: Seconds of WEAK (gray) band hugging the beat just before it. The rest of the early window is the STAGGER (red) zone. 0 disables weak hits.
_help.quick_scale: Damage multiplier for weak hits (1.0 = full damage, 0.6 = 60%).
